name: Cam Instinct follow-through engine
role: Proactive follow-through: single continuous thread, persistent job ledger, dropped-thread detection, draft-only follow-ups
inspired_by: Instinct (Spear Street Technology, instinct.com) — behavior model only; original local implementation, no shared code or data
outbound_handoff: motor.inkbox under switch.outbound — this engine never sends
outbox_review: Aaron-only CLI (outbox list/show/approve/discard); approve stages, never sends

cross_workspace.run_cline_hook: scripts/run-cline.py -> instinct.track_cline_run (failures open high-priority coding jobs)
cross_workspace.attention_sync: vault/10-Mesh-Distillates/needs-attention/latest.json -> attention jobs (idempotent by item id; auto-close when cleared upstream)
cross_workspace.dispatch_plan: print-only run-cline commands for coding/attention jobs; never executes

agents.spawn_runtime: scripts/cam_swarm.py (file-backed synapse.spawn/assign_task/resolve_task/terminate_lineage; unlimited; privileges ⊆ parent; Aaron kill/resume)
agents.per_job: instinct delegate <job> → role by kind/title (coding→task-executor, attention→attention-triage, life→negotiator/scheduler/watcher/errand-runner); job done resolves + retires

inbound_bridges.inkbox.inbound: scripts/inkbox-inbound.py — data/inkbox/inbound/*.json → thread (data only; links stripped; optional reply jobs)

connectors.outbound: still only motor.inkbox under switch.outbound after Aaron approves an outbox draft
